    Corrections in each weight component, for a grading by any abelian group #

    The version of WeightExt.lean for an additional grading by an arbitrary abelian group Γ (lem:square-zero-selected-lifts, last sentence): a Γ-grading of Λ (GrΓ), of the modules (MGr compatible with the actions), and a correction H with dH = F for F of weight w replaced by its weight-w component (PW0Γ, PW1Γ, dPW0Γ, dPW1Γ). The component is computed on homogeneous inputs (PW0Γ_hom, PW1Γ_hom); cochains agreeing on homogeneous inputs agree (ext_oneΓ, ext_twoΓ).
